description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ShortPasswordException' used within the OpenMRS API to indicate that a password is too short. It extends the 'PasswordException' class and is part of the 'org.openmrs.api' package.

classes.name: ShortPasswordException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling cases where the password length is below the minimum requirement, extending PasswordException.

methods.name: ShortPasswordException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a default error message indicating a short password.

methods.name: ShortPasswordException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom error message to be specified when creating the exception.
